title: BEN2
description: BEN2 (Prama LLC, 2025): cuts the foreground out of a photo as a soft mask (background removal); a Swin Transformer looks at the whole image and at four full-resolution patches…
html:
BEN2 (Prama LLC, 2025): cuts the foreground out of a photo as a soft mask (background removal); a Swin Transformer looks at the whole image and at four full-resolution patches and merges the views. MIT code and weights.

Commercial use: yes.

Details
  • Paper: BEN: Using Confidence-Guided Matting for Dichotomous Image Segmentation, arXiv, 2025-01-08
  • Original code: https://github.com/PramaLLC/BEN2 at 2c99a5da477b
  • Code licence: MIT (permissive); files: LICENSE
  • Weights licence: MIT
  • Licence evidence: https://huggingface.co/PramaLLC/BEN2/blob/e48a20765fb421d19dcdb0bf3cc61e802ca5ec8f/README.md ; https://github.com/PramaLLC/BEN2/blob/2c99a5da477b5523585bfa5c893888a6e818a8f6/LICENSE
  • Training data: DIS5K (dichotomous image segmentation), Prama LLC proprietary segmentation data (BEN2 card: "BEN2 was trained on the DIS5k and our 22K proprietary segmentation dataset"; it implies DIS-VD stayed out of training ("RMBG 2.0 did not preserve the DIS 5k validation dataset"). Only the weights licence (MIT) counts for the commercial flag.)
  • Kernel libraries: cudnn_hacc, igev, cutlass_conv
  • Variants: ben2
  • Outputs: alpha
  • Input size: any H x W >= 32, padded to a multiple of 32
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): ben2 3000x4000 (1.8 GiB peak allocated, 2.7 reserved)
  • ben2 1080x1920, first call: portable + torch.compile 71 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 140 s (ONNX + engine).
  • ben2 original 1080x1920: the authors' mixed-precision option (float16); PramaLLC/BEN2@2c99a5da477b BEN2.py, bicubic resize / normalisation / bilinear back / min-max
  • ben2 load / first call: original 2.29 s / 0.926 s, portable 0.3 s / 0.66 s, kernels 1.4 s / 0.425 s
  • Protocol, first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

Measured

Each image at its own size against its binary mask: MAE of the alpha, max F-beta (beta^2 = 0.3) over 256 thresholds (BiRefNet's evaluation). Original = the original code named under Details, same checkpoint and protocol.
